english:
Holding a Glaive or Machine Gun readied within 15 meters of 3 or more enemies grants 35 Stability and 35 Reload Speed to Glaives and Machine Guns.

Glaive Projectile and Melee Kills and Machine Gun Kills restore 50 HP, with a 2 second cooldown between heals.

The stat bonus persists for 5 seconds after the conditions are no longer met. The healing does not persist.
